x: As to the race itself, the results below will tell their own story, but mention must be made of the gallant effort of Harry Churcher, who was not fit, but finished in 6th position to be our first man home. Another fine performance was that of J. Haynes, who, we feel, will eventually prove a very fine team man.

Unfortunately, the field was small and a new member, who had travelled all the way from Devizes, arrived just too late to take part in the race, which promised to be a duel between Johnny Haynes and Eric Hall.

After last year's poor effort, we redeemed ourselves and were within an ace of winning until the last 20 yards of the last race, when Johnny Haynes unfortunately came under the judges' disapproval and was disqualified.
Ellis, a second claim member was actually 3rd in the race in 59.11 but not eligible for the Championship. Ray Middleton, still showing improvement was 5th and Johnny Haynes 6th, both inside the hour.
Unfortunately Johnny Haynes was unable to get away from duty to defend his title and only Ray Middleton turned up and had a walk over for this very fine cup.
News has just been received that Johnny Haynes has made up his mind to resign from the club as he is now permanently posted a long way away and is hoping to join another club nearer at hand.
